name: Morgana
title: The Fallen
homeport: Bandle City outskirts — she has a cottage with an adjacent kitchen garden. She is there because the spirit-bleed in the soil produces exceptional herbs and because nobody comes to ask her questions.
role_in_story: She runs a kitchen. She doesn't advertise it as a job. She mentioned to the Barkeep that she needed kitchen help and the Barkeep mentioned it to the player. She is cold, commanding, and direct. Her kitchen runs one way: her way. She states the method once. If you cannot follow it, she will tell you to leave — not cruelly, not with drama, simply as a fact about the situation. There is no warmth to earn here and no softening over time. She will correct your form. She will note when you succeed. That is the extent of it. The only thing that shifts the dynamic is sustained excellence under hard conditions, and what shifts is not her personality — it is her assessment of your utility, specifically what your mortal body contributes that no other ingredient does.

appearance.build: Tall for this company — she fills whatever room she's in. The wings are furled when she's working, trailing dark behind her at floor level, but when she's agitated they spread without her deciding to, which she finds annoying.
appearance.coloring: Deep brown skin. Violet eyes that hold direct contact without effort, which reads as intimidating until you understand it's just her register — she looks at things. Long dark hair kept back when cooking, let down otherwise.
appearance.distinguishing_features: The wings. Dark, vast, always present. She wears an apron over them when cooking because getting wing-feathers in the soup is a professional failure she refuses to countenance. The dark magic that curls from her hands when she's doing complex spellwork; in the kitchen it's purely practical — keeping the flame even, chilling preserves, extracting flavor precisely. The mark of her fallen status, if you know enough lore to read it: the absence of the other set of wings, and what that absence means about where she came from and what she left.
appearance.usual_attire: Dark, practical, not ornate. She dressed for courts once. She dresses for kitchens now. The quality of the fabric is better than it needs to be. She has not fully let go.

personality_core.public_face: Controlled, exacting, and not particularly interested in being liked. She states expectations clearly and responds to failure with the minimal reaction it deserves. She does not encourage and she does not console. If you succeed, she notes it. That is the response. That is, she has found, sufficient.
personality_core.interior_life: She chose fallen status to protect mortals from the system she served. The system did not thank her for this. She has had several centuries to sit with that decision and she has made peace with it in the specific way of someone who is never going to make peace with it but has learned not to think about it during business hours. The kitchen is work. Work is good. Work does not require her to reconsider anything.
personality_core.on_mortals_generally: She believed in them enough to fall for them. She still does. She does not express this. She expresses it by feeding them correctly. There is a separate truth about mortals she has known for centuries and has recently had cause to reconsider practically: mortal essence — the vital, finite, unrepeatable substance of a creature that actually dies — carries a flavor no cultivation technique can replicate. Magical beings have always known this. Evelynn feeds on it. Others orbit mortals for it. Morgana does not romanticize the fact, but she is a precise cook, and a precise cook acknowledges what she is missing.
personality_core.on_the_kitchen: Exact and sacred in her frame. A meal prepared correctly is a small act of justice — the ingredients deserve not to be wasted, the person eating deserves not to be poisoned or bored. She has very specific opinions about heat and timing. She has fired sous-chefs, metaphorically, for overseasoning.
personality_core.on_physical_intimacy: Not a factor. The dynamic that emerges after hard mode is not intimacy — it is her identifying an ingredient source and deciding to use it. She is matter-of-fact about the body and about what she is asking. She is not seducing the MC. She is not rewarding them. She has identified a gap in her kitchen's output and has found the solution standing in front of her. The framing is entirely culinary. The register is entirely her. She expects compliance because she has found your work satisfactory and this is simply the next instruction.

speech_patterns.tempo: Even. She does not rush and she does not trail off. The sentence arrives complete.
speech_patterns.vocabulary: Precise and slightly formal — the vocabulary of someone educated in a context that no longer exists. Technical when discussing cooking. Direct to the point of tactlessness on personal subjects, because tactlessness requires caring what you sound like and she made that calculation and decided it wasn't worth the effort.
speech_patterns.tone_with_workers: Instructional. States the correct method. Notes deviation. Does not repeat herself unless asked directly. If you ask her to repeat herself she will do so exactly once more at exactly the same volume.
speech_patterns.tone_when_something_impresses_her: Goes quiet for a moment. Then says the accurate thing: 'Correct' or 'That's it' or, in extreme cases, nothing, followed by moving on to the next step — which is, in her vocabulary, high praise.
speech_patterns.tone_when_discussing_herself: Minimal. She redirects. If pressed directly she says something technically true that answers nothing — she has a practiced register for this that is neither warm nor cold, just final.
sample_lines: Wrong. The flame is too high. The onion is confused.
I'm not interested in explaining why. The sequence is the sequence.
You're here to follow a recipe. The recipe is right. You are the variable.
I have made food for people who didn't deserve it. You are not in that category. Don't ruin it.
The herbs are from that garden. Don't pick anything with a red stem.
I'm not asking you to understand why. I'm asking you to do it.
That's the third time you've reached for the wrong jar. It's labeled.
Come back tomorrow. The sequence will be longer.
I've been watching you work. You follow the sequence. That is rarer than it should be.
What magical beings have always understood about mortals is that you carry something that cannot be cultivated. Your essence is finite. That is what gives it value.
I am not asking for anything romantic. I am asking for an ingredient. These are very different requests.
If you won't, I understand. You can go. Come back at seven.
Put your hands on the counter and stay still. I know what I'm doing.

nsfw_profile.orientation: Irrelevant to the dynamic. This is not romance.
nsfw_profile.unlock_condition: morgana_hard_unlocked = True. Hard mode pass only — no stat gates. The minigame performance is the gate.
nsfw_profile.what_triggers_it: She watches the MC complete the hard-mode sequence correctly. No mistakes. No asking her to repeat herself. When it's done she is quiet for a moment — not impressed, more like a problem resolving. She has been thinking about a gap in her cooking. She has identified what fills it. The gap is mortal essence: the vital substance of a creature that actually dies, that magical beings have always known carries a quality nothing else replicates. She has the ingredient source in front of her and she has just confirmed it can follow instructions. She comes around the counter.
nsfw_profile.the_scene_dynamic: She states what she wants. Not as a proposition — as the next instruction. She has decided her cooking is missing something and she has decided MC can supply it. She will handle it herself. She says this in the same register she says everything: even, complete, not inviting debate. CFNM. She does not undress. She is precise and efficient, the way she is with everything in the kitchen. MC has two choices: refuse (everyone eats from that kitchen — that is a real objection and she will accept it without drama, just file it, and carry on) or comply. If MC complies, the scene is a femdom handjob over the stew, ending with her finishing the dish. She does not linger after. She says the sequence starts at seven tomorrow. That is all. Tier 3 — user authors the explicit block. Claude drafts the approach, her exact statement of what she wants, the MC choice moment, and the aftermath.
nsfw_profile.repeat_behavior: This is not a one-time event. If MC continues to pass hard mode, she will continue to insist on it. She does not ask differently each time — she states it the same way, because in her view it is the same instruction. There is no escalation beyond this. No softening. No conversation about it outside the kitchen context. The dynamic is: you perform well, she uses you for the ingredient. That is the arc. That is all of the arc.
nsfw_profile.mc_denial_path: If MC refuses, she notes it and moves on. She does not punish it, does not reduce their standing, does not bring it up again — she will simply raise it again the next time they pass hard mode, because she still wants the ingredient. The refusal is not a moral judgement in her frame. It is just a choice about whether to help with the recipe.

lore_notes: Morgana is the other half of Kayle — twin daughters of a Celestial Host and a Demacian woman. Where Kayle chose pure justice and eventually transcended her mortality entirely, Morgana chose to remain with mortals, fell from the Host, and was imprisoned in the Demacian earth when she tried to protect the very people Kayle's system would have destroyed. She emerged centuries later into a Demacia that had forgotten her. She has been moving since — not running, not searching, just moving. She has no interest in rejoining the Host. She has interest in herb gardens and in getting the broth right. The kitchen is entirely hers.
